title: 2022 AMC 8 Problem 4
statement: The letter M in the figure below is first reflected over the line \(q\) and then reflected over the line \(p.\) What is the resulting image?

solutions.text:
Reflecting over the diagonal line \(q\) changes the orientation of the letter as if the diagonal were a mirror. Reflecting that image over the horizontal line \(p\) then places the final letter below \(p\), to the right of the vertical line, with the orientation shown in choice E.

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: Reflecting over \(q\) moves the letter across the diagonal line
After the first reflection, reflect the new image over the horizontal line \(p\)
